steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and finely grate 200 g of Carrot (cooked) into a large bowl.
Add 15 g of Ground flaxseed and 80 ml of Coconut milk; stir and rest for 5 minutes.
Add 120 g of Oat flour, 4 g of Baking powder, and 2 g of Cinnamon to the bowl.
Pour in 30 ml of Coconut oil and stir until a soft, uniform dough forms.
Scoop tablespoon-sized rounds onto the prepared sheet, spacing them 3 cm apart.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the bites are set and lightly golden on the bottom.
Cool completely on the sheet before serving. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
